t: The Magnusson loft hatch conversion kit is an essential accessory for hinging and securing loft trap doors. This kit is ideal for builders, carpenters, and DIY enthusiasts undertaking loft access improvements or renovations in residential properties across the UK. It includes all necessary fixings, such as a catch operator, travel stop ring, catch lever, nut, location bracket, 11 screws, and 2 x hinges, ensuring a complete and secure installation. The kit is compatible with most standard loft hatches, providing a reliable solution for safe and easy loft access.
b: For Hinging & Securing Loft Trap Doors
